mapper.select: select approve_status, count(id) from asset_card where is_deleted = false group by approve_status

SELECT ac.id, ac.code, ac.name, ac.type, '' as typeName, ac.unit, ac.qty, ac.change_method, ac.org_id, ac.org_name, ac.status FROM asset_card ac WHERE ac.is_deleted = false AND ac.approve_status = 'approve'
AND ac.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.code}, '%')
AND ac.code >= #{params.startCode}
ORDER BY ac.code ASC LIMIT 100
